title: LibScript Tier 4 Declarative Workload Payload Specification
description: Technology-agnostic workload schema translated by Tier 4 schedulers into Kubernetes, Nomad, Mesos, 8+ Native Init supervisors, MicroVMs/Unikernels, and XPK/Slurm AI/HPC jobs.

name.description: Unique identifier for the workload payload

version.description: Semantic version of the workload payload specification

description.description: Human-readable summary of the workload's function

type.description: Workload scheduling classification determining lifecycle and orchestration semantics

artifact.description: Execution artifact definition supporting OCI containers, Tier 1 _lib components, or Tier 2 unikernel images

format.description: Packaging format of the executable workload artifact

image.description: OCI container image URI when format is oci-image

component.description: Tier 1 _lib/<category>/<component> identifier when format is libscript-component

kernel_path.description: Path to compiled unikernel or microVM vmlinux binary when format is unikernel-binary

entrypoint.description: Executable entrypoint command array overriding default artifact entrypoint

args.description: Command-line arguments passed to the workload entrypoint

working_dir.description: Working directory path for workload execution

env.description: Non-sensitive environment variables injected into the workload runtime

resources.description: Compute, memory, GPU, and TPU accelerator requirements per replica or slice

cpu_cores.description: Number of CPU cores requested per workload instance

memory_mb.description: Memory allocation in megabytes requested per workload instance

gpu_type.description: Optional GPU model identifier (e.g. nvidia-h100-80gb, nvidia-l4)

gpu_count.description: Number of GPUs requested per workload instance

tpu_accelerator_type.description: Google Cloud TPU accelerator type for AI training or inference (e.g. v4-8, v5litepod-16, v5p-128)

tpu_slice_count.description: Number of TPU slices scheduled together for multi-slice training

scaling.description: Replication count, deployment rollout strategy, gang scheduling, and restart policies

replicas.description: Desired number of concurrent workload instances or workers

strategy.description: Rollout replacement strategy during workload updates

gang_scheduling.description: Require all replicas/slices to be scheduled simultaneously as an atomic gang (used by XPK, Ray, and Slurm)

restart_policy.description: Supervisor restart behavior upon process exit

ports.description: Network ports exposed by the workload for service discovery and ingress routing

name.description: Logical port name (e.g. http, grpc, metrics)

visibility.description: Whether the port is restricted to internal cluster mesh or exposed via public ingress

tenant_bindings.description: Logical multi-tenant resource bindings for databases, virtual hosts, zero-leak secrets, and persistent volumes

tenant_id.description: Unique tenant identifier passed to logical lifecycle hooks (provision_tenant)

requires_database.description: Single logical database requirement provisioned via hooks/provision_tenant

db_name.description: Logical database or schema name to provision

db_user.description: Database role or user granted access to the tenant schema

requires_databases.description: Multiple logical database requirements for polyglot workloads

virtual_hosts.description: Ingress virtual host rules bridged to _lib/networking/netctl via traits/ingress

server_name.description: Fully qualified domain name for the virtual host

path.description: URL path prefix routed to the workload

target_port.description: Backend workload port receiving proxied traffic

tls.description: Enable automated TLS termination via traits/tls

secret_refs.description: Secret references fetched and injected via traits/secrets/exec_with_secrets with zero environment variable leakage

name.description: Logical placeholder name substituted into configuration templates

key_path.description: Path or key identifier within the secret store

volume_claims.description: Persistent storage mounts managed by traits/storage

mount_path.description: Target path inside the workload runtime

source.description: Device path, NFS export, SMB share, or GCS bucket URI
